summary: Jumia Technologies AG filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026 via a press release. The filing reports a 39% revenue increase to $50.6 million, 32% GMV growth, and a 32% narrowing of adjusted EBITDA loss to $10.7 million. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly earnings release. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. What to watch: Continued progress toward profitability and operational leverage.
